title: Atom created from input via String.to_atom (elixir) — review required
description: The elixir sink String.to_atom creates an atom from text. Atoms are not garbage collected and the VM has a fixed atom limit, so attacker-chosen text can exhaust the table and crash the node. This lexical rule flags the sink; the reviewer confirms the text is trusted or bounded.
remediation: Use String.to_existing_atom with a fixed allowlist for external text.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any atom conversion matches, including constant input.
